filter_lemma: A unit square lies in the closed disc of radius sqrt(2)/2 about its centre and its interior in the open disc, so squares whose centres are at least sqrt(2) apart have disjoint interiors. Pairs are kept for decision when dx^2 + dy^2 < 2, compared exactly over Q from the certificate's centres; both routes check that every square is a unit square whose corner mean is that centre.
